notes.title: The 1.3.2 Hotfix is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35198270/fc864470efef220a0bbba80831623fc996cb8b1b.jpg[/img]

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

	THIS BUILD IS THE HEAVIEST BUILD I'VE RELEASED SO FAR!
	
	I'M PACKAGING THE HOTFIX AS THE CURRENT BUILD IS UPDATING. IT SHOULD BE AVAILABLE AS SOON AS MY INTERNET CAN GET IT UP TO YOU!
	
	LOWERING SHADOW QUALITY IS USUALLY THE FIX IF YOU HAVE PERFORMANCE ISSUES!
		OTHERWISE, TRY LOWERING OTHER VIDEO SETTINGS UNTIL YOU ARE AT YOUR DESIRED FRAMERATE!
	
	FATAL ERRORS ARE ALMOST ALWAYS RELATED TO PERFORMANCE ISSUES. IF YOU ARE EXPERIENCING CRASHES TRY REDUCING YOUR GRAPHICS SETTINGS.
		IF THIS DOESN'T HELP, CONTACT ME WITH SOME REPRODUCTION STEPS AND I'LL GET IT RESOLVED ASAP!
	
	IF YOU ARE HOSTING A LISTEN SERVER (I.E. USING YOUR GAMING COMPUTER TO HOST A MATCH) AND IT KEEPS CRASHING, YOUR PC IS NOT POWERFUL ENOUGH TO HOST AND YOU WILL NEED TO WAIT UNTIL DEDICATED SERVERS ARE OUT.
	
	I'M NOT ABLE TO MAINTAIN THE WEBSITE AND SUPPORT CONTACT. IF YOU HAVE ANY ISSUES, PLEASE CONTACT ME AT 
		
		fractuminnovations@gmail.com 
		
		TEMPORARY SOLUTION: https://entropikz.github.io/Primordium---Day-Zero/
	
[h1]CHANGES/FIXES[/h1]
[list]

	[*] Added an In Game browser.

	[*]	Testing a fix that should stop zombies from walking into walls in the Quarantine level.

	[*]	Added some new models and FX for abilities. They should look a bit better now.
	
	[*] Significantly increased AI health. Bullets won't be as OP.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that made A.I. see doors as obstacles.		
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that prevented guards from taking damage in the Prologue.		
		
	[*] Fixed an issue that spawned an enemy in the tutorial.		

	[*] Fixed a crash in multiplayer.
							
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h1]
			
	[*] For the moment, I am using text to speech for dialogue. I plan on replacing this as soon as possible.
			
	[*] I'll be adding the pickaxe to the default items in the next hotfix so it's easier to harvest rocks/metals.
			
	[*] The tutorial isn't very good. I'll be slowing it down and adding more functions in the next few updates.

	[*]	Alt Tabbing will clear focus for your mouse. If you hold alt tab and double click on the game screen to return it will resolve the issue. I'll have this fixed as soon as possible, but it looks like it might be an engine issue from what I've seen on the forums.
	
	[*] Cinematics for the Research Center mission aren't firing. The mission is alway way too short. I'll be updating this in the next few versions.

	[*] The Administration level is going to be completely revamped. It's way to small to fight in.

	[*] Boss fights are kinda lame. I'll be adding some cool FX later on.

	[*]	Body modifications are not showing up properly (this is why I added the coming soon screen in the customization menu).

	[*] Guide pictures are all displaying the raw meat icon for now. I'll have new pictures soon!

	[*] The guide panel (and some other menus) look a little weird. I'll be slowly adjusting these through the hotfixes.
	
	[*] AI movement can be a little weird inside of buildings. I'll be improving this over the next few updates.

	[*] Abilities are still W.I.P. please contact me at the support email to let me know what issues you have!

	[*] Player profile icons aren't being saved right now.

	[*] The cloud sim/planet atmospheres look pretty bad. I'll have it fixed up when the other issues are cleaned up!

	[*] The terraforming tools aren't working.

	[*] The scanner doesn't do anything when activated.

	[*] The faction menu isn't showing in multiplayer. I'll have this fixed in the next update.

notes.title: Day Zero 1.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]This update resolves a number of issues related to the Campaign, building system and inventory system. I'll be working on content and visual updates next![/h1]

[h1]ADDITIONS::[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added objectives to the nexus to help with resource farming.
[*] Added widget to make tutorial exit more intuitive.
[/list]

[h1]CHANGES:: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced number of enemies to intro quest to make it easier to finish the quest without running out of ammo.
[*] Increased spawn rate for enemies and objectives.
[*] Changed loot box to dead body.
[*] Moved exploration log to journal.
[*] Set all unity network menus to visible.
[*] Changed font in multiplayer menu.
[*] Removed diplomacy from journal.
[*] Removed most of the georgia fonts in favor of standard font.
[/list]

[h1]FIXES::[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked foundations on planets.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused spacecraft to spawn in floor.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked A.I. movement in campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue that let player warp through planets.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented objective from being removed after completed.
[*] Fixed an issue that let player dual wield the same item.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed spaceships to fly through solid objects.
[*] Fixed an issue that placed drag drop and inventory right click menus at the wrong offsets for various screens.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked Anima from being possessed after using the Oculus.
[*] Fixed an issue with damage indicator.
[*] Fixed an issue with buttons not getting disabled after multiplayer session is created or joined.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Anima camera being set a little low.
[*] Fixed an issue with a player card was not getting properties.
[*] Fixed an issue with auto run turning off after you released the key.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player card not gathering the right properties.
[*] Fixed some performance issues with A.I.
[*] Fixed performance issues with bullets hitting terrain.
[*] Fixed low lighting issues in campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue that let user open pause menu when building menu was open.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES:: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Attachments aren't being removed (visual only) until item is toggled.
[*] Dual wielded weapons don't use offhand animations.
[*] Hand does not move to grip point.
[*] Some items do not line up with the player's hand.
[*] Some items do not line up with the current sheath.
[*] Going prone will let player look through ground if on slope.
[*] Gamepad input isn't working properly.
[*] Switching weapons gives the player a full magazine.
[*] Slots do not change colors when hovered.
[*] AI are resetting their animations when they die.
[/list]

notes.title: Day Zero Season 1.2 update!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Day Zero 1.2 update is here! This update brings a massive amount of bug fixes and adjustments, while also adding a massive amount of features! Including multiplayer![/h1]

[h1][b][u]ADDITIONS::[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] 	Added gravity vector to ship.
[*] 	Added display info for ships in the ship hangar.
[*] 	Added method that blocks ship and vehicle hangars until the power has been turned online.
[*] 	Added method that blocks Unity Network until the power has been turned online.
[*] 	Added text to menu title button to make version changing more intuitive.
[*] 	Added method to block save game if versions don't match. (This will not work with games saved before this update).
[*] 	Added citizen NPCs
[*] 	Added basic orbit simulations.
[*] 	Added NPC's that give quests. They can be found in settlements on The Nexus and around different planets that are inhabited by sentient life.
[*] 	Added gravity vector to projectiles.
[*] 	Added method to block warp if ship is in gravity well.
[*] 	Added method to zero velocity after warp.
[*] 	Added method to block warp if collision detected.
[*] 	Added Star/Gas giant harvesting.
[*] 	Added Hyperdrive to Spaceship engine.
[*] 	Added simple fuel system for spaceship Standard Engine, Hyperdrive and Warp Field.
[*] 	Added custom solar system generator.
[*] 	Added hoverbike vehicle.
[*] 	Added SUV vehicle.
[*] 	Added Pickup Truck vehicle.
[*] 	Added Hatchback vehicle.
[*] 	Added Box Truck vehicle.
[*] 	Added Sports car vehicle.
[*] 	Added diplomacy rewards to objectives.
[*] 	Added custom jobs for crew members.
[*] 	Added bullet damage to vehicles.
[*] 	Added more objectives.
[*] 	Added Nexus Refinery.
[*] 	Added Nexus Club.
[*] 	Added Nexus Research Center.
[*] 	Added "Steady" state for ADS to reduce recoil when firing a ranged weapon. The steady state can be accessed by holding the sprint key.
[*] 	Added object to adjust Nexus lights based on power status.
[*] 	Added support for vehicle/RTS HUDs.
[*] 	Added new cheat code. Check the in-game guide for more details.
[*] 	Added player card.
[*] 	Added function to kill passengers and driver on vehicle death.
[*] 	Added behavior for AI to responsd to stats.
[*] 	Added support for multiple player icons.
[/list]
	
[h1][u][b]CHANGES:: [/b][/u][/h1]

[list]
[*] 	Changed visibility for multiplayer button.
[*] 	Changed intro customization to support Alien and Anima customization.
[*] 	Changed intro character model to make it more obvious that you are an alien.

[*] 	Changed planet generation scripts.
[*] 	Changed Nexus terrain.
[*] 	Changed crafting system to only use timestamps. This means that the progress bar has been removed.
[*] 	Moved player icon to player card.

[/list]

[h1][u][b]FIXES::[/b][/u][/h1]

[list]
[*] 	Fixed an issue that threw off gravity vector depending on your speed.
[*] 	Fixed an issue with tutorial widget scaling.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that made character bounce off of ship.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that showed map icon over players head instead of on minimap.

[*] 	Fixed an issue that prevented tutorial from showing crafting menu.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that prevented character creation from showing up in v 1.1 campaign.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that let player warp through planets if moving too fast.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that prevented cheat codes from working.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that created two game slots when a new slot was created.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that blocked pause menu when flying in ship.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that didn't show inventory when flying in ship.
[*] 	Fixed an issue that made buttons and text change size randomly.

[h1][u][b]NOTES::[/b][/u][/h1]

notes.title: Questions about the 1.1.0 update.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I received a question regarding the 1.1.0 update so I wanted to make an announcement to address the issue just in case it popped up for anyone else.

The 1.1.0 update is designed to preserve your old save files. In order to access the new 1.1.0 content, you will want to start a new game.

I will add an in-game message in the next update to make sure everyone knows what's going on!

Thank you again for your feedback and support. Words cannot express how much I appreciate your patience and kindness as I work out all of the kinks!

notes.title: Day Zero 1.0.2 Hotfix!
notes.notes:
CHANGES::

- Fixed an issue that allowed user to open other menus when inventory is open.
- Fixed an issue that allowed duplicating armor by left clicking the slot.
- Fixed an issue that placed tutorial information overlay over the UI.
- Fixed an issue that blocked player from using items after swinging weapon.
- Fixed an issue that caused the HUD to glitch on certain monitors. 
	+ This was caused by the curvature effect added to the HUD. This has been removed, but will return in a later update as an option that can be enabled or disabled.
- Updated AI pathing to allow for path updates while moving.
- Added a Game Modes menu to make it easier to drop into scenarios.
- Moved Sandboxes to a Game Modes menu.
- Added a button to show Game Agreement.
- Added a keybindings menu.
- You can now move your camera when sitting in the Command Console.
- Added a new achievement. More will be added as future updates come through!

KNOWN ISSUES:: 

- Removing an attachment will still allow you to drag the attachment icon throwing an error notification while adding an invalid item to your inventory.
- AI can get stuck, preventing them from moving or attacking. This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next update.
- Player is using wrong hand when drinking or eating. This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next update.
- Certain weapons have attachments that should not have attachments.
- Removing an attachment from pistol can cause the pistol to be removed from your hotbar and added to your inventory.
- Switching from weapons while they are held could add them back to your inventory.
- Player might spawn under world on load game. This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next build.
	+ While it is not the most ideal option, you can fly back up through the world using the Modifier 3 Key (Default C) while jumping.

NOTES::

- The game will take longer to load if you alt-tab during a loading screen, but will eventually come back if you give it time.

notes.title: Day Zero 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A small hotfix has been rolled out for Day Zero Season 1.

The issues addressed can be found below.

- Fixed an issue that broke player animations after entering the command console in the intro.

- Fixed an issue that broke player rotation after entering the command console in the intro.

- Fixed an issue that sometimes spawned the player out of the space station in the intro.

- Fixed an issue that made the Harbinger spawn above the landing platform in the intro.

- Improved content spawn rate in landing zones.

- Fixed an issue that prevented HUD visibility from being restored after solving puzzles.

- Fixed an issue that prevented player from getting reward after a puzzle was solved.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Exploration & Diplomacy Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This new update includes improvements to the exploration and diplomacy system.

I've added an encoded notes system that will contain journal entries from different characters. Each note is encrypted with a series of unique keys. Collect all of the keys to unlock the notes!

The diplomacy system includes passive quests that will give you unique rewards as well as a new UI for viewing and managing your relations.

You'll also see some minor bug fixes and adjustments, new items and more improvements to the planet generation algorithm.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 0.0.1 - Modular Weapons!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for the support and feedback! 

I'm preparing to release a small patch for the Day Zero's pre-release.

The update will include a new main menu map and fixes to the multiplayer loading screen.

I've also fixed the issue with the interaction brush so it displays the proper key and the NPC loot tables have been fixed so they can no longer spawn empty loot bags. This means you'll always get loot no matter what!

The patch should be out after I finish testing the new fixes. Once I've confirmed there aren't any scary bugs lying around, I'll get it out to anyone who has access to the game.

Stay tuned for more updates!
